name: qlrisk_price_clo
title: Price a CLO
description:
Price one Collateralized Loan Obligation (qlrisk CLO).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 100} gives NPV 68.98 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
